text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан is weighed down with
fatigue, so I
decide to take her to the
infirmary and let her
rest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thanks for taking care of me! I was
feeling really
tired.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Now, if you'll excuse me, I think I'll go
lie down
for a bit.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Huh? Where am I?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Hey... Listen to our voice... Can ya hear
us?
Wh-what?! Who's talking?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Over here... Yeah, Мэдзиро Райан, right
here...
N-no way... The voice is coming from...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Inside me? Wait... It's my muscles?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
You got that right. We're your strong,

well-defined muscles—everything that's
keepin'
your body together.
text_block_list.name: Ryan's Muscles

text_block_list.text: Are you... for real?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Wow, thank you so much for everything!
Ever
since I was little, I've wanted to say
this.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Thank you for growing strong with me!
You're,
like, my number one partner!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
You got it, Ryan. Yeah... Don't ever let
up on
rockin' the weights and grabbin'
those sweet
gains!
text_block_list.name: Ryan's Muscles

text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah! I'll show you just how strong we
can get!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: We'll keep working out... together!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Oh... Wh-where am I?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Uh, it's nothing... I just had a strange
dream, I
think.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: But I talked to them... To my muscles!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Thanks, Ryan... But we gotta tell ya...
text_block_list.name: Ryan's Muscles

text_block_list.text:
Forget pumpin' all that heavy iron...
Imagine
this—eatin' a huge tray of tasty
treats... then
sleepin' in alllll day...
Yeah...
text_block_list.name: Ryan's Muscles

text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wh-what'd you just say?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I never knew my muscles felt this way...
Is that
what you really want?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: W-wait, muscles! Don't gooo!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Gasp!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list: You were tossing and turning... What's wrong?

text_block_list.text: Oh, uh... Huh?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
It feels like I had a bad dream... but I
can't
remember any of it...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure I understand what she
means... but it
seems like Мэдзиро Райан's
condition is improving.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: It looks like Мэдзиро Райан didn't rest well.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
